pages.lesson:
LESSON: BHAGWAT GITA

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Scriptures
Topic 4.1: Bhagwat Gita

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Bhagwat Gita. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is Bhagwat Gita?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. handle the Scriptures appropriately
2. appreciate the importance of Bhagwat Gita as a Scripture. 4.2 Introduction to Kalpasutra (4 lessons) appropriately
3. appreciate the importance of Kalpasutra as a Scripture. open the scriptures

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. handle the Scriptures appropriately
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to handle the Scriptures appropriately. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the importance of Bhagwat Gita as a Scripture. 4.2 Introduction to Kalpasutra (4 lessons) appropriately
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of Bhagwat Gita as a Scripture. 4.2 Introduction to Kalpasutra (4 lessons) appropriately. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the importance of Kalpasutra as a Scripture. open the scriptures
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of Kalpasutra as a Scripture. open the scriptures. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Bhagwat Gita.
2. Explain Bhagwat Gita to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Bhagwat Gita.
4. Show that you can: handle the Scriptures appropriately
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Bhagwat Gita. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What is Bhagwat Gita?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. handle the Scriptures appropriately
2. appreciate the importance of Bhagwat Gita as a Scripture. 4.2 Introduction to Kalpasutra (4 lessons) appropriately
3. appreciate the importance of Kalpasutra as a Scripture. open the scriptures

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
